cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So what does a data engineer actually do?
cues.zh: 資料工程師到底做什麼？

cues.en: Let's start off with three big words that we need to understand before we really understand what a data engineer does.
cues.zh: 真正理解工作之前，先認識三個重要術語。

cues.en: Yes, I know.
cues.zh: 對，我知道。

cues.en: I keep circling around data engineer and I keep getting you excited, but I promise we're getting really, really close.
cues.zh: 我一直繞著資料工程師這個主題，吊你胃口，但保證已經非常接近了。

cues.en: We just need to discuss these three words that you may or may not have heard of.
cues.zh: 只需要先討論這三個你可能聽過、也可能沒聽過的詞。

cues.en: One is data mining, and data mining simply means pre-processing and extracting some knowledge from the data.
cues.zh: 第一個是資料探勘，簡單說，就是對資料做前處理，並擷取一些知識。

cues.en: So we use some sort of data to extract knowledge from.
cues.zh: 使用某種資料，從中擷取知識。

cues.en: That's what data mining is.
cues.zh: 這就是資料探勘。

cues.en: Big data?
cues.zh: 那大數據呢？

cues.en: Well, it means that we have a lot of data, a lot of variables, so much data, in fact, that you can't run on your laptop.
cues.zh: 表示有大量資料、大量變數，資料多到沒辦法在筆電上處理。

cues.en: There's just too much data for your laptop or computer to hold.
cues.zh: 筆電或電腦根本容納不下。

cues.en: Usually when we talk about big data, it's data that's so big that you need to have it running on cloud
cues.zh: 通常說到大數據，就是大到必須透過雲端，

cues.en: computing or multiple computers such as a AWS Azure and Google Cloud because they have a lot of computers
cues.zh: 運算或多台電腦處理，例如 AWS、Azure、Google Cloud，因為它們有很多電腦，

cues.en: and a lot of storage to store this data.
cues.zh: 以及大量儲存空間。

cues.en: So that's why big data is big data is data that you usually can't have just on a one computer.
cues.zh: 所以大數據通常不是單一電腦就能容納的資料。

cues.en: This usually happens because, well, data sets gets so big.
cues.zh: 這種情況通常是因為資料集規模變得太大。

cues.en: We have petabytes and petabytes of data now.
cues.zh: 現在資料量已經達到許多 PB。

cues.en: So just having data in a database like MySQL or post grass or any type of database becomes really difficult
cues.zh: 如果 MySQL、PostgreSQL 或其他資料庫，只在一台，

cues.en: when that database is just one single machine.
cues.zh: 機器上執行，就會很難處理。

cues.en: Now, new technologies were invented to solve this problem of big data like Hadoop and NoSQL, which we'll talk about.
cues.zh: 為了解決大數據問題，出現了 Hadoop、NoSQL 等新技術，稍後會談。

cues.en: Now a data pipeline is essentially a pipeline that a data engineer builds to essentially use the fact
cues.zh: 資料管線則是資料工程師建立的一套流程，

cues.en: that we have this big amount of data, we need to extract information from this data using data mining.
cues.zh: 面對大量資料，需要透過資料探勘，從中擷取資訊。

cues.en: So we need to bring or build a pipeline that allows us to flow from that unknown large amount of data
cues.zh: 因此需要建立管線，讓那些未知、龐大的資料，

cues.en: to a pipeline that extracts data to a more useful form.
cues.zh: 經過擷取，轉成更有用的形式。

cues.en: So a data engineer essentially does this creates a data pipeline where all the information that different
cues.zh: 資料工程師基本上就是建立資料管線，處理各種，

cues.en: devices like Iot devices, mobile applications, web apps, cameras, cars and pretty much anything
cues.zh: 物聯網裝置、行動應用程式、網路應用程式、攝影機、汽車，幾乎所有，

cues.en: that collects data and stores information or logs data into servers or to the cloud.
cues.zh: 會收集資料、儲存資訊，或把紀錄寫到伺服器、雲端的裝置。

cues.en: A data engineer essentially accumulates all this information into nicely packed databases and storage
cues.zh: 工程師將所有資訊整合到整理好的資料庫與儲存，

cues.en: engines so that different parts of the company can create visualizations, they can monitor the performance
cues.zh: 引擎，讓公司不同部門能建立視覺化、監控產品，

cues.en: of their product, they can get business insights and make business decision from this data and even use this data on their apps.
cues.zh: 表現、取得商業洞見、根據資料做決策，甚至直接在應用程式使用資料。

cues.en: For example, for user profiles before a data scientist or a machine learning expert or even a business intelligence or data analyst gets hired for a big company.
cues.zh: 例如使用者個人資料。大公司聘請資料科學家、機器學習專家、商業智慧人員或資料分析師之前，

cues.en: The thing that they need to do before all of that can be done is to hire a data engineer.
cues.zh: 在這些工作開始前，需要先聘請資料工程師。

cues.en: They build the pipeline that allows us to work as data scientists.
cues.zh: 他們建立管線，讓我們得以進行資料科學工作。

cues.en: Remember this diagram and how we've been focusing on this part.
cues.zh: 記得這張圖，以及一直著重的這部分嗎？

cues.en: Well, a data engineer allows us to do this data collection part.
cues.zh: 資料工程師協助完成資料收集這一塊。

cues.en: They bring in all this information, organize it in a way for us to do our data modeling.
cues.zh: 把資訊帶進來，整理成適合進行資料建模的形式。

cues.en: They really help us with this data collection part that usually as a machine learning engineer or data scientist, you don't have to concern yourself too much with.
cues.zh: 在資料收集方面提供很大幫助，而機器學習工程師、資料科學家通常不必太操心這一部分。

cues.en: But you know what?
cues.zh: 不過你知道嗎？

cues.en: My favorite demonstration of what a data engineer is is in the next video.
cues.zh: 我最喜歡的資料工程師示範，會在下一支影片。

cues.en: I hope you're excited because things are going to start to make more and more sense.
cues.zh: 希望你很期待，因為事情會越來越清楚。

cues.en: I'll see you on that one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。

cues.en: Bye bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
